label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: RICH replica of the g4sim task package (examples/ams02-rich-replica, status synthetic): radiator, foil, conical mirror, detection plane

user_supplied.note: the task package's replica, a Geant4 simulation built from public parameters (Section E12); make_replica.py writes this case's three specifications from rich_params.cfg

cherenkov_handling.note: Section 10.4 and E12: efficiency maps do not apply to Cherenkov light; the replica tracks every photon

quantities.name: aerogel_photons_at_plane
quantities.definition: mean number per event of the optical photons the primary (parent track 1) emits in the aerogel (emission z 470.75 to 495.75 mm) that enter the detection plane, before any digitization; a 100 GeV proton straight down through the full aerogel tile at (226, 0) mm, 300 events
quantities.derivation: rich_sim.cc (SHA-256 128ecf26...) built here against the same Geant4 11.4.3 and run with --species p --ekn 100 --theta-max 0 --point 226 0 --n 300 --seed 1: hits with horigin 1 and hprim 1, 126.71 per event, sd 14.70, se 0.85 (.g4sim-work/rich-replica/ref.root). Tolerance 3%: three times the combined statistical error of two 300-event samples (3 x sqrt(2) x 0.85 / 126.7 = 2.8%), fixed before the g4sim run
sources: the task package's rich_sim.cc and rich_params.cfg (user-supplied, synthetic)

independence.result: not independent of Geant4: both numbers are Geant4 simulations of the same parameters (a comparison with another simulation, Section E12): a regression and consistency check, never validation

negative_control.change: aerogel tiles 20 mm thick instead of 25

approximations: The 32 aerogel tiles rich_sim.cc clips to the 600 mm aperture with a boolean intersection are left out: arbitrary CSG is outside g4sim's shape list (Section 2.2), a core-module requirement (Section 13.2); the beam crosses a full tile far from them

NaF tiles 84.75 mm at a pitch of 84.75 mm instead of 85: rich_sim.cc's 340 mm NaF square overlaps the 339 mm hole of its aerogel lattice by 0.5 mm on each side (it places volumes without an overlap check); g4sim's gap rule refuses the overlap

The detection plane is a 1 mm vacuum slab with a skin of efficiency 1, as rich_sim.cc's recording slab; its quantum efficiency, light-guide losses, pixels and central hole belong to its Python digitization and are not compared

rich_sim.cc sets Cerenkov MaxPhotonsPerStep 300, MaxBetaChange 10 and TrackSecondariesFirst; g4sim's run card has no such settings and keeps Geant4's defaults (they split steps; the expected photon number does not change)
The rich volumes sit in a 2000 x 2000 x 1800 mm optical-vacuum box, rich_sim.cc's world; g4sim's world outside it has no refractive index
status: comparison with cited values: not validated
